virtual_run.title: Zero offset — physical setup required
steps: Select terminals
Use the front-panel FRONT/REAR switch to select the FRONT terminals.
Set up the input
Leave CURRENT input OPEN (no calibrator connected).
virtual_run.caution: The 5560A stays in STANDBY. Confirm the terminal selection and physical setup before measuring.

virtual_run.title: Zero offset — physical setup required
steps: Select terminals
Use the front-panel FRONT/REAR switch to select the FRONT terminals.
Set up the input
Install a low-thermal-EMF copper four-terminal SHORT across INPUT HI/LO and SENSE HI/LO. Do NOT use the 5560A as a zero source.
virtual_run.caution: The 5560A stays in STANDBY. Confirm the terminal selection and physical setup before measuring.
